thread:
Tara (Sales): Heads up - Orion Mutual needs fully air-gapped on-prem deployment, HSM support (PKCS#11), and no outbound connections. Target delivery 10-12 weeks. RFP: https://r.j/Orion-RFP
Ravi (PM): thanks. we should split must vs nice. must = HSM + offline installer + audit log export to their collector. nice = console UI, automated backups.
Ken (Eng): feasibility: core runtime works offline. work: PKCS#11 adapter, packaging offline images, upgrade-from-media flow, terraform examples for customer VPC. estimate 7-11 weeks eng + 1-2 weeks integration.
Ana (SRE): need clarification: do they want our control plane or self-managed? self-managed means no egress and more ops on their side.
Tara (Sales): they want self-managed. will provide hosts and bastion.
Ravi (PM): triage decision: create backlog epic 'self-managed airgap installer (HSM)'. acceptance criteria: installer runs without internet, keys via PKCS#11, offline upgrade documented, audit logs to customer collector, perf validated. priority: P1 for this account.
legal-bot: reminded: BAA/SLA required before pilot.
Ravi (PM): action items: Tara - confirm infra dates and get SOW signed (due Tue). Ken - post JIRA task breakdown + HSM vendors to test (Thales, CloudHSM, Yubi). Ana - runbook template + rollback plan.
Tara (Sales): will chase infra window.
Ken (Eng): will post tickets by Fri.
